name: docs-lookup
title_zh: 终端里敲两下就拿到库文档最新版
tagline_zh: API 记不准、调用报错、库不熟？不用开浏览器翻旧文档。敲一条命令，context7 直接给你当前版本的权威说明。
tagline_en: Uncertain API, failing call, unfamiliar library? Skip the stale browser tabs. One command pulls the exact.
desc_en: Fetch focused, current library documentation through the context7 REST API from the terminal, no key or MCP needed. Use when an API surface is uncertain, a call fails against the installed version, or a library is unfamiliar. Not for general questions the model already answers.
why_zh: 它不猜，它去查。基于 context7 REST API，按你本地装的版本号拉对应文档，回答里带出处。
why_en: It doesn't guess—it fetches. Hits context7's REST API with your installed version, returns cited docs. More reliable than model.
limit_zh: 只回答库的用法与参数，不解释通用编程概念。需要联网；context7 未收录的冷门库查不到。输出为文档摘要。
limit_en: Only library usage & params, not general coding concepts. Needs internet; obscure libs missing from context7 return nothing. Output is doc digest.
title_en: Fetch current library docs from terminal, no key or MCP.
